content: The clinical interaction studies between famciclovir and cimetidine demonstrated no significant effects on the formation of penciclovir. Felbamate increases the levels or effects of cimetidine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Felodipine also increases the levels or effects of cimetidine via the same mechanism involving CYP2C19 metabolism, with the clinical significance remaining unclear. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of fesoterodine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Fluconazole increases the levels or effects of cimetidine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of fluphenazine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of flurbiprofen by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of fluvastatin by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of green tea by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism. Green tea may contain caffeine, and CYP1A2 inhibitors can inhibit the hepatic oxidative metabolism of caffeine. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of ibuprofen by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of intravenous ibuprofen by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Isavuconazonium sulfate increases the levels or effects of cimetidine through mechanisms other than hepatic enzyme metabolism. Isavuconazonium sulfate, an OCT2 inhibitor, may enhance the effects or levels of OCT2 substrates. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of loratadine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of losartan by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. This interaction may inhibit the conversion of losartan to its active metabolite, E-3174. The clinical significance of this interaction is not established, and individual therapeutic responses should be monitored to determine losartan dosage. Modafinil increases the levels or effects of cimetidine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels of ospemifene by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Oxcarbazepine increases the levels or effects of cimetidine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Parecoxib increases the levels or effects of cimetidine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels of pefloxacin by decreasing its metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Pentobarbital decreases the levels or effects of cimetidine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of perhexiline by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of perphenazine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Phenobarbital decreases the levels or effects of cimetidine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine decreases the levels of phytoestrogens by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of piroxicam by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Primidone decreases the levels or effects of cimetidine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of prochlorperazine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of promazine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of promethazine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of ramelteon by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of cimetidine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of riluzole by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of risperidone by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of sulfamethoxazole by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of tolterodine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of trifluoperazine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of tropisetron by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels of varenicline by decreasing renal clearance. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Voriconazole increases the levels or effects of cimetidine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. Conversely, cimetidine increases the levels or effects of voriconazole by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of these interactions is unknown. Acalabrutinib increases the levels of cimetidine through mechanisms other than hepatic enzyme metabolism. Conversely, cimetidine decreases the levels of acalabrutinib by increasing gastric pH, which applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Acalabrutinib solubility decreases with increasing gastric pH. It is recommended to administer acalabrutinib two hours before an H2-receptor antagonist. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of alfentanil by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of alfuzosin by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of alosetron by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. It also affects hepatic enzymes CYP1A2 and CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of these interactions varies, and alternative therapies are recommended in some cases. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of alprazolam by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of amiodarone by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of amitriptyline by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Amobarbital decreases the levels or effects of cimetidine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of amphetamine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of antipyrine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Apalutamide decreases the levels or effects of cimetidine by increasing elimination. Apalutamide weakly induces BCRP and may decrease systemic exposure to drugs that are BCRP substrates. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of aripiprazole by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. It also affects hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. The clinical significance of these interactions varies, and alternative therapies are recommended in some cases. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of armodafinil by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, armodafinil increases the levels or effects of cimetidine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of these interactions is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of artemether/lumefantrine by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of asenapine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of atazanavir by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, cimetidine decreases the levels or effects of atazanavir by increasing gastric pH, which applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Atazanavir solubility decreases as pH increases, leading to substantially reduced plasma concentrations of atazanavir when coadministered with H2-receptor antagonists. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of atogepant by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of atomoxetine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of atorvastatin by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of avanafil by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. CYP3A4 inhibitors may reduce avanafil clearance, increasing systemic exposure and associated adverse events. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of avapritinib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels of axitinib by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the effects of azelastine by decreasing its metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of bazedoxifene/conjugated estrogens by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the effects of belladonna and opium by decreasing their metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the levels of bendamustine by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism, leading to decreased conversion to active metabolites. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of benzhydrocodone/acetaminophen by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Hydromorphone, a metabolite of hydrocodone, may contribute to the total analgesic effect. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Berotralstat increases the levels or effects of cimetidine by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of bexarotene by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Blessed thistle decreases the effects of cimetidine through pharmacodynamic antagonism. This interaction is theoretical, and the clinical significance is unknown. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of bortezomib by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of bosentan by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. It also influences hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. The clinical significance of these interactions is unknown. Bosutinib increases the levels of cimetidine by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Conversely, cimetidine increases the levels of bosutinib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of brexpiprazole by influencing hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. It also affects hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Cimetidine decreases the effects of budesonide by increasing gastric pH, which applies only to the oral forms of both agents. The dissolution of extended-release budesonide tablets is pH-dependent. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of budesonide by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the effects of buprenorphine by decreasing its metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the effects of buprenorphine buccal by decreasing its metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Cimetidine increases the levels or effects of buspirone by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative therapies are recommended. Butabarbital decreases the levels or effects of cimetidine by influencing the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown.
